g.text: Caption. Per-family MAE on the 374 val rows (reused development set). Family rules: wiki/RESIDUALS_D023.md; the binary B/C/N family has n = 14 and the oxide family n =

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: 36, so those bars are imprecise. Magpie-only bars: each of the 9 reference seeds contributes its best-val equation at complexity <= 12 (the CLAUDE.md headline selection;

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: mean 3.98 overall), the mean over seeds is drawn and the whiskers span the seeds. c5 and c8 are single equations from c020_s0 chosen as frozen candidates before the

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: residual analysis; they are not seed-averaged, and d_023 was screened on train and scored once on val before adoption. Per-family MAE is an exploratory diagnostic, not

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: pre-registered; the SVR and the formulas differ in inputs and supervision, so the deficit does not isolate formula compactness.
